Plates under a white-light shield that regrows over time. Requires power: the shield only stands while the wall holds power - unpowered, the field drops and enemies walk through the gap. Build plenty, with a generator or battery in reach.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Defense |
| Main crystal | Obsidian |
| Build cost | 25 Obsidian |
| Upgrades give | +HP, +Shield, +Shield Recharge |

## Levels

The cost on level 1 is the build cost; on later levels it is the cost to upgrade to that level.
